Priya S.: Hey team — quick QA on a new joiner logistics for Jae Park (starts Mon). Background check came back as 'name similarity' and passport shows expiry in 30 days. I need to confirm whether we can still run I-9 kiosk + day-1 orientation in-office or if we should delay.

Devon L.: Ugh. Name-similarity flags usually need the manual reviewer to clear. How long is the review queue today?

onboard-bot: Background check case 039128: status "manual review" — ETA 24–48h. Assigned to: Zara H.

Zara H.: Picking this up now. Will ping the vendor for identity docs matching.

Priya S.: Thanks. About the passport: it expires in a month but is currently valid. For I-9 we can accept it if it's not expired on the day of verification, right?

Ari M.: Correct — unexpired passport meets List A. We do need original physical docs present at the kiosk. If they get a renewal pending, that's trickier.

Devon L.: One wrinkle — courier can't deliver the laptop to the downtown satellite after 5:30pm. Jae's flight lands late Sunday. We usually let new joiners pick up at the front desk, but the building requires pre-registered badges for guests.

Priya S.: Could we set up a locker pickup? We used locker code flow for interns last summer.

Ari M.: Yes, locker pickup works. I can request a locker and temporary access code. Need name, phone, and expected pick-up window.

Priya S.: I'll DM Jae for phone and ETA. For the orientation swap: current cohort orientation is Monday AM — if background check holds past Monday, should we move Jae to the Wed afternoon mini-orientation (same content, shorter Q&A)?

Zara H.: If the vendor clears in 24–48h we might still make Monday. But to be safe, let's tentatively move Jae to Wed PM and then move back if cleared sooner. Avoids day-of scrambling.

Priya S.: Cool. I'll mark tentative. Can someone confirm whether payroll/electronic W-4 signing needs to happen before first full week to trigger benefits?

Devon L.: Benefits enrollment opens as soon as payroll entry processed. Ideally W-4 + direct deposit by EOD Tuesday to avoid benefit delays. Not a blocker for day-1, but flag for the buddy.

Priya S.: Noted. Also need I-9 acceptable documents snippet to send to the candidate — will paste below. Please verify I'm not missing anything.

Priya S.: ```
Acceptable documents (examples):
- List A: unexpired US passport OR permanent resident card
- List B + List C combo: driver's license (state-issued) + social security card
Bring originals, not copies. Kiosk staff will inspect IDs in-person.
```

Ari M.: That's perfect. Add a note: "If passport is under renewal but current passport still valid on start date, bring the current passport."

Priya S.: Will add. Logistics check list for the courier/locker: 
- Laptop to be delivered to Locker #12 
- Pickup window Mon 9:00–18:00 (we'll extend to 20:00 if candidate confirms earlier flight)
- Temporary badge code: TBD by Ari
- Escort to onboarding room scheduled Wed 1:30pm if orientation moves

Courier Ops: Confirmed — locker reserved. Courier requires contact phone and pickup time to add to manifest.

Priya S.: Sending DM to Jae now to confirm phone + ETA. Zara, please update the background-check ticket once you hear from the vendor.

Zara H.: On it. I'll update case 039128 with vendor notes and flag ProdOps if we need expedited handling.

Devon L.: One more thing — parking pass. New hires on hybrid plan get a 1-week visitor permit. Priya can you confirm arrival date so I can add to the parking manifest?

Priya S.: Arrival Mon — I'll include that in the DM.

onboard-bot: Reminder: update the "Day 0 checklist" when moving orientation slots. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/checklists

Priya S.: Thanks everyone :raised_hands: I'll follow up after I hear from Jae and Zara.

Ari M.: I'll prepare the locker code and temporary badge request template.

Courier Ops: Manifest updated when Priya sends phone. Locker code will be sent to the candidate's phone only.

Priya S.: Quick follow after DM — Jae can pick up between Mon 6–7pm. Flight delayed but passport is valid on day-1. Background vendor replied and asked for a middle-name confirmation — Zara, I added that in the vendor portal.

Zara H.: Thanks. Vendor cleared after middle-name confirmation. Marking background-check case 039128 as cleared at 2350001180.

Priya S.: Awesome — leaving orientation as Monday AM then. Devon I'll leave payroll heads-up re: W-4 by Tuesday. Ari please send the badge code and locker PIN to Jae.

Ari M.: Sent badge code + locker PIN to candidate phone at 2350001185.

Courier Ops: Laptop placed in Locker #12 at 2350001187.

Priya S.: All set. Closing loop. :tada:
